scraped_replies.html:
Hello @JS_,

It looks like the MCU device has been set as a board in the intermediate JSON file (stm32cubeide-export.json). Could you share the JSON section that indicates the MCU/Board configuration? The JSON file should be located in the destination folder.

Could you also share the MCU and Board configuration visible in STM32CubeIDE?

In the meantime, you can opt in to the option to skip this check, and relaunch again the conversion. You will be invited later to configure your project and select the device or board:
scraped_replies.author: Julien D
